query:
From this email, extract the single URL that is the password reset link for the service named 'TechServices'. If this is not a TechServices password reset email or there is no reset link, return an empty string in reset_link. Choose the link explicitly intended to reset the password, not links to help centers or general login pages. Email Subject: TechServices Password Reset Request. Email Body: Dear Emma,

We received a request to reset your password. If you did not make this request, please ignore this email. Otherwise, click the link below to reset your password:

[Reset Password](https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei)

Best,
Tech Services Support
